dct_description_sm: Cycle 12 collected data from persons 15 years and older. The core content of time use repeats that of  Cycle 7 (1992) and Cycle 2 (1986), and provides data on the daily activities of Canadians. Question modules were also included on unpaid work activities, cultural activities and participation in sports. The target population of the General Social Survey consisted of all individuals aged 15 and over living in a private household in one of the ten provinces.  Please be advised that several minor revisions to the GSS 12 microdata file were required.   The variables that have been updated are SIC80C13, SIC80C18, SOC91C08, SOC91C10, NAICS16, SOC80C10, BLISH12, PINEOC06 and HLTHPR7.  As a result, the main file and the user guide have been updated as of 24 December 1999.  New as of 30 April 2001 The micro-data file for Cycle 12 has been modified, and the main data file replaced.  The FAMTYPE variable has been modified, in certain cases, where the respondent was living in a household with more than one family. Unfortunately, the user of the PUMF cannot check whether the respondent was living in such a household since the number of families is not included in the file.  The counts for the LFSHSD12 variable were modified to include those respondents in a common-law relationship, who were not retained as having a spouse in the first counts.  The counts for the 'not stated' and 'not applicable' values for variables in the section concerning the respondent's spouse (variables ACMPRWEC, G3, WKWEPR, WKWEHRPR, WKDYPR, G7, G8ST, G8EN, G9ST, G9EN, WKDYHRPR, G10, G10A, G11, G11A, G12, EDUPR10) were modified to include spouses in a same-sex common-law relationship. The latter are now found in the 'not applicable' category rather than the 'not stated' category, since the questions in this section were not asked.
